what: Fabricator capability evidence for the A7 design-rule delta (0.5/0.2 mm vias). Quoted rows only; the page itself is not redistributed.

source.note: sha256 of the HTML as served to an anonymous client at retrieval; the live page changes, the quoted rows are what was read

rows.quote: Multilayer: 0.15 mm hole size / 0.25 mm via diameter
Via diameter should be 0.1mm(0.15mm preferred) larger than Via hole size.
0.1mm or 0.15mm hole size with any size via diameter, and 0.2mm or 0.25mm hole size with via diameter less than 0.45mm, will cost more.

rows.row: Inner layer via hole to copper clearance

rows.quote: Finished copper weight of inner layer is 0.5oz by default.

reading: 0.5 mm pad / 0.2 mm drill: drill equals the preferred minimum, pad exceeds drill by 0.3 (>= 0.15 preferred), and the diameter is >= 0.45 so the hole is outside the extra-cost class. Annular ring 0.15 keeps the A5 min_via_annular_width. Rule hole-to-track (0.2) matches A5 min_hole_clearance.
